title: Rebuild T3 center-lifecycle isolation for threaded discussions
verify: Retained prior-center root/reply messages, message reactions, authors, common-feed entries, and branch tabs are neither projected nor mutable after supported class identity reuse, while current-center threaded discussion remains usable.
Arbitrary reply depth, first-reply branch activation, ten-tab ordering, hidden-message retention, and reactivation remain intact under the center-scoped public boundary.

evidence: Fresh verifier-owned isolated probe passed on two runs, covering retained prior-center discussion denial, arbitrary depth, first-reply activation, feed separation, message reactions, ten-tab ordering, hidden retention, reactivation, and safe cleanup.
npm run check, npm run build, npm run test, and git diff --check passed; executor results remain supporting-only.
Independent hostile review found no material cross-center privacy, ownership, persistence, boundary, or scope drift in the TASK-017 outcome.

purpose: Re-establish the protected Collaboration boundary for threaded messages, replies, message reactions, common feed, and recent branch tabs after supported center identity reuse exposed retained prior-center discussion data.
success_outcome: Threaded discussions remain arbitrarily deep, retained, correctly tabbed, and scoped to the current center/class/student context; retained prior-center branches cannot be read, targeted, mutated, or attributed through the replacement lifecycle.
anti_goals: Do not edit, re-tier, close, or reuse TASK-012-T2-FT-004-W6 as this task.
Do not inherit TASK-012 Attempt 1/2 evidence as current T3 proof or change TASK-012 lifecycle.
Do not delete hidden messages, cap reply depth, or move threaded-discussion ownership outside Collaboration.
Do not change the accepted modular-monolith graph, shared database decision, or public boundary.
constraints: Collaboration exclusively writes messages, replies, message reactions, branch activity, and tab projections; actor and class/student scope are resolved through the accepted public boundaries.
Every protected message read, reply/reaction target check, and mutation combines the authenticated actor with server-resolved center/class/student scope.
The one shared database retains prior message branches; hidden branches are retained rather than deleted and recent tabs remain a projection.
Verification uses isolated disposable state, safe rerun, and cleanup with no network, credentials, or production data.
invariants: Cross-center message, reply, branch, tab, author, and reactor reads and mutations are denied without revealing unrelated object existence.
Reply depth remains arbitrary, the first reply activates a branch tab, and the common feed contains every message available in the current scope.
At most ten most recently active current-center branch tabs are visible; hidden messages and branches remain retained.
Prior-center threaded discussion rows remain retained and behaviorally unchanged after a replacement-center lifecycle.
verification_targets: FT-004-AC-003: public-boundary matrix for arbitrary-depth replies, first-reply branch activation, scoped common-feed completeness, message reactions, and center identity-reuse isolation.
FT-004-AC-004: public-boundary matrix for eleven-plus branch ordering, ten-tab bound, hidden-message retention, reactivation, and center identity-reuse isolation.
REQ-014 / .memory-bank/contracts/access-control.md#authority-and-scope: every protected discussion read and command uses actor plus server-resolved center/class/student scope.
.memory-bank/contracts/boundary-map.md#day-discussion-query-boundary: Collaboration remains the sole writer and Lesson Context consumes only the named scoped public boundary.
.memory-bank/domains/core-domain.md#domain-relationships: explicit shared/personal discussion context, parent/root relationships, and retained branch behavior remain coherent.
.memory-bank/states/lifecycle-map.md#collaboration: arbitrary-depth message branches and recent-tab lifecycle remain valid.
.memory-bank/testing/strategy.md#evidence-and-ownership: task-scoped RED/GREEN, state-before/state-after, safe rerun, and cleanup evidence.

stop_conditions: Stop and route to /spec-design if satisfying the accepted boundary requires changing the modular-monolith graph, public contract, or shared database decision.
Stop if threaded-discussion ownership must move outside Collaboration, if hidden messages would be deleted, or if reply depth must be capped.
